questions.text: What does Kamila study at WKU?
questions.hint: "My name is Kamila Dzhaksybekova. I study Economics at WKU."

questions.text: Kamila lives in the WKU student dormitory.
questions.hint: "Unlike most of my classmates, I do not live in the student dormitory. I rent a small apartment near the university."

questions.text: What colour is the sofa in the living room?
questions.hint: "There is a comfortable blue sofa against the wall."

questions.text: There are ___ potted plants on the balcony.
questions.hint: "There are four potted plants on the balcony — Zara brought them from her home in Almaty."

questions.text: What is on Zara's bedside table?
opts: A book and a phone charger
questions.hint: "Zara's has a small cactus plant!" — Kamila's bedside table has a book and a phone charger.

questions.text: There is a bathtub in the bathroom.
questions.hint: "There is no bathtub — only a shower."

questions.text: How much does each girl pay for rent per month?
questions.hint: "Our apartment costs 80,000 tenge per month — we each pay 40,000."

questions.text: Which appliance is in the kitchen but NOT in the apartment?
questions.hint: The kitchen has a fridge, microwave, kettle, and washing machine — but NO dishwasher. Kamila confirms this in the dialogue.

questions.text: How many rooms are there in Kamila's apartment?
questions.hint: "There are three rooms: a living room, a kitchen, and a bedroom." — Kamila.

questions.text: There is a separate study room in Kamila's apartment.
questions.hint: "No, there isn't. But there is a desk in the bedroom for each of us." — Kamila answers Damir's question.

questions.text: How many plants are there in total in the apartment (balcony + bedroom)?
questions.hint: "There are four plants on the balcony and one in the bedroom." — Kamila. 4 + 1 = 5.

questions.text: There is a small ___ just around the corner from Kamila's apartment.
questions.hint: "Yes, there is a small park just around the corner. Very peaceful." — Kamila tells Damir.

questions.text: Kamila's only complaint about the apartment is that there isn't a washing machine.
questions.hint: "There is no dishwasher! That's the only problem!" — Kamila. The apartment DOES have a washing machine.

questions.text: What does Damir see when he looks from the balcony?
questions.hint: "There are so many trees down there!" — Damir, after Kamila shows him the balcony view of the courtyard.

questions.text: "There ___ a blue sofa in the living room."
questions.hint: Sofa = singular noun → "There IS a sofa." (There IS + singular)

questions.text: "There are two bookshelves near the window" is correct English.
questions.hint: "Bookshelves" is plural → "There ARE two bookshelves." ✓ (plural noun = are)

questions.text: "Is there a dishwasher in the kitchen?" — "No, there ___."
questions.hint: Short answer to "Is there...?" in negative = "No, there ISN'T." (singular)

questions.text: "Are there ___ plants on the balcony?" — "Yes, there are four!"
questions.hint: In questions, we use ANY: "Are there ANY plants?" (not "some" — some is for positives/offers).

questions.text: Which sentence is correct?
opts: "There is two bookshelves in the room."
"There are a bookshelf near the window."
"There are two bookshelves in the room."
"There is some bookshelves on the wall."
questions.correct: "There are two bookshelves in the room."
questions.hint: "Two bookshelves" = plural → "There ARE two bookshelves." (Never "is" with a plural noun.)

questions.text: "There isn't any noisy neighbours in our building" is correct English.
questions.hint: "Neighbours" is plural → use "aren't": "There AREN'T any noisy neighbours." (ISN'T is only for singular.)

questions.text: "___ there a lift in the building?" — "No, there isn't — we walk up the stairs!"
questions.hint: "Lift" is singular → question form: "IS there a lift?" (Are there = only with plural nouns.)

questions.text: Kamila describes the balcony: "There ___ four beautiful plants."
questions.hint: "Four plants" = plural → "There ARE four plants." (plural = are, not is).

questions.text: What is a "bookshelf"?
opts: A shelf on the wall for storing books
questions.correct: A shelf on the wall for storing books
questions.hint: Bookshelf (книжная полка) — "There are two bookshelves near the window — full of textbooks and novels."

questions.text: A "landlord" is the person who rents an apartment FROM the owner.
questions.hint: Landlord (хозяин/арендодатель) = the OWNER who rents the apartment TO others. The person who rents FROM them is called a "tenant".

questions.text: The opposite of "noisy" is ___.
questions.hint: Noisy (шумный) ↔ quiet (тихий). "There are no noisy neighbours — the building is very quiet."

questions.text: What does "spacious" mean?
opts: Large and with plenty of space
questions.correct: Large and with plenty of space
questions.hint: Spacious (просторный) — the opposite of cramped. A spacious apartment has a lot of room to move.

questions.text: Which of these is a household appliance?
questions.hint: Appliance (бытовой прибор) = an electrical machine. A washing machine, fridge, and microwave are appliances.

questions.text: A "lift" takes you between floors of a building.
questions.hint: Lift (лифт) — "There isn't a lift, so we walk up three flights of stairs every day!" — Kamila.

questions.text: The room where you sleep is called a ___.
questions.hint: Bedroom (спальня) — "Zara and I share one bedroom. There are two single beds on opposite sides."

questions.text: What does "convenient" mean?
opts: Easy and practical to use or get to
questions.correct: Easy and practical to use or get to
questions.hint: Convenient (удобный/практичный) — "There is a washing machine, which is very convenient for students."
